general.subtitulo: Cessation, case closure and changes to dates or working hours
general.ayuda: To record the end of employment, enter the reason, effective date and supporting document. Only its reference and a file check code are saved; keep the original. The job pool receives the end date to update availability. The end of employment must be recorded before the case can be closed. If a GINPIX form is required, record the number returned by GINPIX once using “Confirm GINPIX record”. The case cannot close without that confirmation. The centre confirms the start of work through its requests, using the applicable appointment record or signed contract; the date and document type appear here. If the accepted person does not start work, record the reason and decision. Use “Propose failure to take up post” if a second review is required. Another HR officer, different from the proposer and using their own session, must confirm or reject the proposal. It has no effect until confirmed. If no second review is needed, record who made the decision. After confirmation, the case returns for financial scrutiny, the job pool applies the required change and the call can continue with the next person. If rejected, the proposal closes without effect and another can be made. When the next person accepts, their appointment proposal becomes current; the previous one remains in the history with the reason and date of replacement. Further follow-up then concerns the new person. If dates or working hours change, a new analysis version is created, the cost is recalculated and the case returns to the specified stage.
